scope: Documentation review of prescribed mass-rate Direct Source; no model execution or source-code inspection

findings.finding: Rate means gas entering air, not liquid loss from a vessel. Direct bypasses source-strength estimation.
Continuous source uses constant rate and duration in minutes. This review is restricted to greater than one and at most 60 minutes.
Mass entry has no independent source temperature or pressure field. Volume-mode storage inputs are documented for volume-to-mass conversion; they do not establish dispersion source enthalpy.
Limited Direct inputs may not distinguish gas from two-phase release. Warning presence or absence is not a measured phase or flash fraction.
Heavy Gas uses ground-level source even if an entered elevated height is printed. Our zero-height case avoids this particular ambiguity.

findings.locator: 5.4.4 technical documentation sections 4.4 and 4.4.3, printed pages 45 and 50-51
findings.finding: Heavy-gas formulation includes primary-source enthalpy and surface heat flux; ambient pressure is position/time independent and initial jet momentum is omitted. These passages do not specify the 5.4.7 mass-Direct source temperature, pressure value or vapour fraction.

findings.locator: Communicating with ALOHA, March 2009, sections 1-2 and appendices 1-2
findings.finding: Documents map/threat-point exchange and weather input. No source thermodynamic-state query or complete headless scenario-execution interface is established by these sections.

findings.locator: ALOHA Status Files and Pass Files, April 2007, pages 1-3
findings.finding: Documents zone drawing data, display text and receptor coordinates. No typed effective source temperature, pressure, enthalpy or aerosol fraction is specified.

decision: Retain frozen prescribed-gas cases for exploratory runs; source-state equivalence and physical qualification remain pending.
next_evidence: Version-specific explanation of mass-unit Direct initialization and applicability, tied to the installed engine; then archived supervised runs and remaining mapping checks.
